title: Tools and controlled actions
goal: Implement a bounded read-only tool and reason about approval for actions.
case: The assistant calculates a permitted reimbursement cap; a request to update a record needs approval.
terms: A named operation with validated arguments, permissions and a defined result.
Code chooses the next step by a fixed rule.
A model may choose a next action, within the permissions and limits supplied by the application.
A consequential write needs explicit review before execution and an audit record.
steps: Reject a negative or non-numeric amount
Simulate an approval request without a real write
Check that a denied request remains unchanged
example: Policy cap is €40; eligible expense is €55.
A request to change the policy cap is denied until the authorized reviewer approves.
misconception: A tool call chosen by a model is automatically authorized.
correction: The application checks role, arguments and approval independently of the model text.
change: Try a negative amount and confirm the validator blocks it.
metric: Unauthorized successful actions / attempted unauthorized actions (target zero)
lab: Implement a calculator and approval gate simulation.
output: Tool result, blocked-request trace and approval explanation.
